description: Collective Adaptive Systems -- strong resilience. Can the collective (coalition) keep the losses never exceeding the saves, i.e. the attacker never pulls ahead (compromised <= adapted at all times)? Expected TRUE: the collective notifies and adapts a member before the attacker's breach lands each round, so the count of compromised members never overtakes the count of adapted ones. Stronger than <cas>G{compromised < N} (at least one survives): here at least half the collective is always safe.
